# iykyk-action

Install IYKYK's automatic pull-request comprehension questionnaire:

```bash
npx iykyk-action
```

The equivalent npm initializer is:

```bash
npm create iykyk
```

That command creates `.github/workflows/iykyk.yml`. Commit the generated file and IYKYK will run
on every new or updated pull request. It uses GitHub Actions and the included GitHub Models
allowance, so there is no service to deploy and no API key to add.

You may instead install it as a development dependency with `npm install --save-dev iykyk-action`.
It installs the workflow automatically when npm lifecycle scripts are enabled; newer npm security
settings may require `npx iykyk-action` once after installation. The installer is idempotent and
never overwrites an existing workflow.
